text:
mike: quick check — the per-model unit-cost card on the console is showing ~6% higher spend for the canary routing group vs the raw token ledger for the same window. not huge but non-zero, any ideas?
julia: thanks for flagging. is this the 2pm->3pm spike where we did the rollout?
mike: yep that window. looks like cache credits not being applied to canary because route tag was missing in the billing join.
ken: hmm that sounds like the per-route tag propagation issue we patched last month. can you paste the sample event id?
mike: event id `ev_20260321_8143` — here's the simplified join we run:
```
SELECT r.route_id, SUM(t.tokens * m.unit_price) AS token_cost
FROM tokens t
JOIN routes r ON t.route_id = r.id
JOIN models m ON t.model_sku = m.sku
WHERE window = '2026-03-21T14'
GROUP BY r.route_id
```
jenkins-bot: deploy 1717772600 to econ-service succeeded :white_check_mark:
sam: if cache-crediting happens downstream in transform, the route_id can get lost. we had a sed transform that strips metadata when payload > 64kb.
pete: i dug into raw telemetry — the token events have a `meta.route` sometimes nested: `meta->{session->{route}}`. billing join expects `route_id` at top-level.
anya: UX question — if we apply a heuristic to surface "unattributed cache-savings" in the console, where should that live? in the per-model card or a separate "unattributed" line?
julia: separate line + tooltip explaining it's due to missing route tags. product wants visibility for SREs to triage.
ken: technical proposal: add a backfill stage in the econ pipeline that normalizes nested route tags to top-level `route_id` before join. small mapreduce job that retrofits last 24h.
mike: +1. can we also add a warning badge on the per-model card when >1% of cost is unattributed? small guardrail.
sam: agree. also add alert to detect when nested->top-level rate crosses threshold. i can add to alerts.
pete: i'll whip up the backfill query and test on prod-sandbox tonight. will post diffs.
julia: assigning follow-ups: pete -> backfill PR, ken -> pipeline transform fix, sam -> alert, mike -> console badge copy. cc @deploy-bot for rollout.
deploy-bot: rollout scheduled: econ-service transform fix -> canary -> full (ETA 03:45 UTC).
mike: thanks all. will monitor the canary and re-check cost cards in ~1h.
